what: A small photo cell (.9em wide · .72em high) set between two words of a big title widens to 4.2em as you scroll — from when the section top reaches 70% of the screen until the section center is at 40%, with no curve. The photo inside sits centered at the fully open width (4.2em) from the start, so the wider the cell gets, the more of the photo’s sides is revealed

options.to: End width, default 4.2em — photo width follows this too
